authority: Exact static labels, state copy, accessible names and form help are canonical only in the public anatomy/specification documents. Business values and imported/source text are data, not copy to translate or invent.

requiredStateFamilies.meaning: No qualifying record exists; names the next truthful action.
A read is underway; never presents stale values as current.
The command was accepted with revision or receipt.
A provider or job has not yet accepted/completed work.
Draft/request intent exists locally; acceptance is not claimed.
Revision mismatch asks the user to review current facts.
Authority/policy blocks the action, with no hidden workaround.
Field-level validation names the failed field and repair.
The external connection is unavailable/read-only/failed, without fake completion.
A known failure names retry/recovery scope.
Missing evidence/required data names what is still needed.
Retention/redaction/archive state preserves safe identity and recovery context.
Completion wording requires a command receipt, provider acceptance, or issued revision.

rules: Every interactive control receives a programmatic accessible name that matches its visible canonical label unless the specification explicitly supplies an accessible alternative.
Menus, dialogs and forms retain their subject in title, confirmation and failure copy.
Exact state copy distinguishes saved/accepted, queued/provider-accepted and completed/provider-confirmed.
Do not translate, normalize or fabricate business values, source wording, customer data, provider outcome or measured evidence.

Journey acceptance copy must state whether the customer sees prices in chat, on the albaran, in both, or in neither before any customer-facing request; it must preserve accepted business values and never imply external receipt without evidence.

Customer-confirmation and product-option controls retain their independent labels, remembered-choice, no-auto-SKU, no-send preview and durable-write failure copy; an effective-policy explanation never substitutes for a message, price acceptance or provider receipt.
